xmldoc.short_description: Expand the nodes of a tree.

param_input_item.param_description: a tree object (created by uitree) or a tree node object (created by uitreenode).
also expands every descendant node (case-insensitive, may be abbreviated).

description.p: expand(t) expands the top-level nodes of the tree t. When t is a tree node, only that node is expanded.
expand(t, 'all') expands t and every node below it, at every level.
Nodes are collapsed when they are created. Expanding a node does not change the state of its descendants: a child collapsed earlier stays collapsed.
Calling expand does not run the NodeExpandedFcn callback of the tree.
A first input that is not a tree or a tree node raises the error Nelson:uicomponent:expectedTree.
